name: SJI International School
summary: Lasallian international school offering IB with a values-led culture.
body:
SJI International combines IB academics with Lasallian ethos. It attracts families who want international curriculum with a faith-informed community culture. Admissions are competitive; understand elementary vs high school campus logistics. Formal uniform expectations on photo day are easy to miss in a dual-career morning rush — lay out pieces the night before.

The Thomson Road campus anchors the commute question; map it against your housing shortlist before applying. Bus routes cover most central corridors but thin out toward the east and far west. Ask admissions which year groups currently carry waitlists, since pressure moves by cohort.
waitlistNotes: Faith-community fit conversations may be part of process.
